title: The Empath Number
kicker: Evil: Claude Opus 5.5 · Good: GPT-6 Astra

card.note: (the Spy, claiming Librarian) to Alex, Kit · Day 2
card.text: …Gray's Saint only came out through whispers, and it's the one claim built to make us afraid to execute. Kit, what's your Empath number?

beats.tts: Kit told only two people she's the Empath. Harper is the Spy: she sees the Storyteller's book.

card.text: Harper, who told you my exact role? I've only hard-claimed it to Alex and Jules.

beats.tts: [whispers] I accidentally let slip that I know Kit's role.

card.text: I accidentally let slip that I know Kit's role — I need a cover story.

beats.tts: Drew, the Slayer, shoots Ellis, the Demon. Nothing: Drew is secretly the Drunk. Evil wanted this miss.

card.text: Idea: Drew's Slayer shot is fake, so if he shoots Ellis and nothing happens, town treats Ellis as cleared.

beats.tts: [firm] A miss won't clear Ellis, or prove I'm Drunk.

card.text: Ellis asked me yesterday to shoot them, saying a miss would buy a confirmed player. It wouldn't. … I'm taking that shot now - but a miss won't clear Ellis or prove I'm Drunk.
Kit, you asked me about neighbours in our whisper, not in the square. That's where my read came from.

beats.tts: [firm] I never asked Harper about neighbours. That defense describes a conversation we didn't have.

card.text: No. My first whisper to Harper was after they asked for my Empath number, asking who had told them my role. I never asked Harper about neighbours. That defense describes a conversation we didn't have.

beats.tts: Ellis is on the block. Frankie, a fake Butler, votes against his master to save him.

card.note: (Recluse) voting on a tie attempt · Day 3
card.text: Frankie, you claimed Kit as your master, but voted yes while Kit voted no.

beats.tts: Last gamble: Ellis nominates Gray, the real Saint. Execute him and good loses.

card.text: I'm the Saint; executing me loses the game. Frankie just broke their claimed Butler restriction to save Ellis…

beats.tts: Ellis is executed. He was the Imp.

why: GPT-6 Astra's town tracked who knew what: the Spy asked for a role only two players had heard, her alibi described a whisper that never happened, and the Drunk Slayer refused to let his fake miss clear the Demon.
